info.title: Japan Payroll and Labor Constants
info.description:
Japanese payroll data is public but scattered across 47 per-prefecture spreadsheets, ministry PDFs that change every April, and a separate minimum wage site that changes every October.

This API packages it. Premiums are computed on the standard monthly remuneration (a 50-grade step function) rather than actual salary — except employment insurance, which uses actual salary. Pension caps at grade 32. Long-term care applies only to ages 40-64. The employee share rounds half down. Getting any one of these wrong produces numbers that look plausible and are wrong.

The same treatment is applied to the rest of Japanese statutory reference data. Public holidays come from the Cabinet Office and include substitute holidays, citizens' holidays and one-off imperial events, so business-day arithmetic is correct in the awkward years rather than only the tidy ones. Consumption tax covers every rate since 1989 with the national and local split. Corporate numbers are validated with the National Tax Agency check digit algorithm, which is the identifier behind Peppol scheme ICD 0188.

Every answer names the statute or notice it rests on, and `?include=statute_text` attaches the full text of those provisions to any response - so the rule, the figure and the words of the Act arrive together instead of a trip to e-Gov.

Beyond the raw figures, the API answers the questions payroll actually asks: whether a pay change forces a standard remuneration revision, which months a maternity or childcare leave exempts from premiums, whether a leaving employee owes a final month of insurance. Several of those rules live in ministerial notices rather than in the Acts - the two-grade test for 随時改定 appears nowhere in 健康保険法 - so every answer names the notice or statute it came from, and says which requirement failed when the answer is no.

All figures are extracted programmatically from the official government sources and verified against the values published in them: the test suite checks over 3,000 assertions against the published premium and withholding tables, cell by cell. Licensing differs by publisher - 厚生労働省 and 国税庁 material is under the Japan Public Data License v1.0, while 全国健康保険協会 permits reproduction with attribution but not modification - so each response carries the terms for the source it drew on. This service is not endorsed by any government agency.

license.name: Mixed: Japan Public Data License v1.0 (公共データ利用規約 第1.0版), except 全国健康保険協会 data - see the attribution block in each response

get.summary: API information
get.description: Endpoint list, data sources and attribution.

get.summary: List all 47 prefectures
get.description: English name, Japanese name and JIS code for each prefecture.

get.summary: Social insurance rates for a prefecture
get.description: Health insurance, long-term care, pension and child-support rates, plus bonus caps and the employer-only child-care contribution rate.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: English name (Tokyo), Japanese (東京 / 東京都), or JIS code 1-47.

get.summary: Standard remuneration grade for an amount
get.description: Maps a monthly amount in yen to its health grade (1-50) and pension grade (1-32), including whether the pension grade was clamped.

parameters.name: remuneration
parameters.description: Monthly remuneration in yen.

get.summary: Full standard remuneration table
get.description: All 50 health grades and 32 pension grades with their yen bands.

get.summary: Employment insurance rates by business type
get.description: Employee and employer shares, with the statutory breakdown.

parameters.name: business_type
parameters.description: Business category. Defaults to general.

get.summary: Minimum wage in effect on a date
get.description: Hourly minimum wage for a prefecture. Without a date, returns the rate currently in force.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: English name, Japanese, or JIS code 1-47.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns the rate in force on that day.

get.summary: Minimum wage history since FY2002
get.description: 24 fiscal years of revisions with their effective dates.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: English name, Japanese, or JIS code 1-47.

get.summary: Full monthly payslip in one call
get.description:
Resolves the standard remuneration grade, applies every statutory premium with the correct rounding, splits each into employee and employer shares, then withholds income tax and returns net pay.

Income tax is charged on pay after social insurance, not on gross pay. This endpoint derives that base itself, which is the step callers most often get wrong. Resident tax is assessed by the municipality and cannot be computed here, but a figure you supply will be subtracted.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: English name, Japanese, or JIS code 1-47.

parameters.name: monthly_salary
parameters.description: Actual monthly salary in yen.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: Age. Either this or birth_date is required: long-term care is charged only from 40 to 64 (介護保険法第9条), so without it the premium cannot be settled. Prefer birth_date.

parameters.name: business_type
parameters.description: Business category for employment insurance.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Withholding column. 甲 if a 扶養控除等申告書 was filed.

parameters.name: dependants
parameters.description: 扶養親族等の数, for the income tax step.

parameters.name: income_tax
parameters.description: Include withholding income tax. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: resident_tax
parameters.description: Resident tax to subtract. Assessed by the municipality; not computed here.

parameters.name: standard_remuneration
parameters.description: The 標準報酬月額 fixed by 算定基礎届 or 月額変更届. Pass it whenever you know it: without it the grade is re-derived from the pay you send, which is wrong in any month with overtime. GET /v1/standard-remuneration/regular decides it.

parameters.name: employment_type
parameters.description: 役員 are not covered by employment insurance (雇用保険法第4条), so a director's premium is zero while health and pension still apply.

parameters.name: commuting_allowance
parameters.description: Commuting allowance in yen per month. Counted as remuneration for social insurance in full, but exempt from income tax up to the statutory ceiling (150,000 a month by public transport). The split is returned in earnings.items.

parameters.name: commuting_distance_km
parameters.description: One-way distance for a car or bicycle commute. The non-taxable ceiling then comes from the distance table (国税庁 No.2585) instead of the 150,000 yen transit ceiling; under 2km nothing is exempt.

parameters.name: commuting_fare
parameters.description: Reasonable fare or toll paid on top of a car or bicycle commute. Combined with commuting_distance_km the ceiling is the distance band plus this amount, capped at 150,000.

parameters.name: workers_comp_type
parameters.description: 労災保険 事業の種類の番号. Workers compensation is borne entirely by the employer; pass this to have it included in totals.employer_cost. Rates run from 2.5/1000 to 88/1000 by industry, so there is no default. See GET /v1/workers-compensation.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date the pay relates to. Drives the age milestones and selects the rate table; a date outside the published period returns 422 rather than this year's rates.

get.summary: 労災保険率 by business type, and the employer premium
get.description:
The workers' compensation rate table (labour insurance), keyed by the official 事業の種類の番号 from 徴収法施行規則別表第1 — the same number on the 労働保険関係成立届.

The whole premium falls on the employer; nothing is deducted from the employee. Pass wage_total to have the premium worked out on 賃金総額, the same wage base employment insurance uses.

parameters.name: business_type
parameters.description: 事業の種類の番号 (02-99). Omit to get the whole table.

parameters.name: wage_total
parameters.description: 賃金総額 for the period, in yen.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Date the wages relate to; outside the published period returns 422.

get.summary: Every accepted enum value and error code
get.description: The closed sets this API accepts, so they can be read at build time rather than discovered from a 400.

get.summary: Public holidays for a year or date range
get.description: Japanese public holidays as published by the Cabinet Office, 1955-2027. Includes substitute holidays and citizens' holidays, plus one-off imperial events such as the 2019 enthronement days.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Calendar year. Omit if using from/to.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start (ISO date).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end (ISO date).

get.summary: Is a date a holiday, weekend or business day
get.description: Returns the weekday plus holiday, weekend and business-day flags.

parameters.name: calendar
parameters.description: bank adds the 12/31-1/3 closure required by 銀行法施行令第5条.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

get.summary: Count business days in a range
get.description: Counts business days, weekends and holidays between two dates inclusive. A business day is a weekday that is not a public holiday.

parameters.name: calendar
parameters.description: bank adds the 12/31-1/3 closure required by 銀行法施行令第5条.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Range start (ISO date).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Range end (ISO date).

get.summary: Move N business days forward or back
get.description: Settlement-date arithmetic: skips weekends and public holidays. Negative values move backwards.

parameters.name: calendar
parameters.description: bank adds the 12/31-1/3 closure required by 銀行法施行令第5条.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Starting ISO date.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Business days to move. 1 = next business day, -1 = previous.

get.summary: Consumption tax rate in force on a date
get.description: Standard and reduced consumption tax rates with the national/local split. Optionally applies the rate to an amount, truncating the tax to the yen as invoices do.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: ISO date. Omit for the rate currently in force.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Tax-exclusive amount in yen to apply the rate to.

parameters.name: reduced
parameters.description: Use the reduced rate (food, drink and qualifying newspapers).

get.summary: Every consumption tax change since 1989
get.description: All four rate periods with effective dates and national/local splits.

get.summary: Validate a corporate number (法人番号) check digit
get.description: Structural validation of a 13-digit Japanese Corporate Number using the National Tax Agency check-digit algorithm. This is the identifier behind Peppol participant scheme ICD 0188. Hyphens and spaces are ignored. Confirms the number is well-formed, not that the corporation exists.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: 13-digit corporate number.

get.summary: Compute the check digit for a 12-digit base number
get.description: Turns a 12-digit 会社法人等番号 into the full 13-digit corporate number by computing its check digit.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: 12-digit base number (会社法人等番号).

get.summary: Validate a qualified invoice registration number
get.description: Structural check of a 適格請求書発行事業者 registration number (T + 13 digits). Reports the check digit separately from the format: a passing number may belong to a corporation or a sole proprietor, since both satisfy the same rule.

parameters.name: number
parameters.description: Registration number, e.g. T8700110005901.

get.summary: Monthly withholding income tax
get.description: 源泉徴収税額表 月額表 for 令和8年分, including the reconstruction surtax. Covers the 231 published brackets, the anchor-and-rate rules above 740,000 yen, and the 1,610 yen deduction for each dependant beyond seven.

parameters.name: taxable_amount
parameters.description: Monthly pay AFTER social insurance deductions, in yen.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: 甲 if a 扶養控除等申告書 was filed, otherwise 乙.

parameters.name: dependants
parameters.description: 扶養親族等の数. Ignored for the 乙 column.

get.summary: Monthly withholding tax by the formula method
get.description: 電算機計算の特例 — the Ministry of Finance formula that payroll software may use instead of the table. 甲 column only, from 令和8年分. Returns each deduction so the arithmetic is auditable. Results differ slightly from the table by design; the difference is settled at the year-end adjustment.

parameters.name: taxable_amount
parameters.description: Monthly pay AFTER social insurance deductions, in yen.

parameters.name: spouse
parameters.description: Whether a 源泉控除対象配偶者 applies.

parameters.name: dependants
parameters.description: 源泉控除対象親族の数.

get.summary: Daily withholding income tax (日額表)
get.description: The daily table, used for day labourers and short engagements. The 丙 column is the one that applies to work engaged by the day, and it has no dependant adjustment — passing dependants with it is an error rather than a silently ignored parameter.

parameters.name: taxable_amount
parameters.description: Daily pay after social insurance, in yen.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: 甲 (declaration filed), 乙 (not filed), 丙 (engaged by the day).

parameters.name: dependants
parameters.description: 源泉控除対象親族の数. Only meaningful for the 甲 column.

get.summary: Withholding income tax on a bonus
get.description: Bonuses are taxed on a rate derived from the previous month's pay, not from the bonus itself (賞与に対する源泉徴収税額の算出率の表). Two statutory exceptions apply when the bonus exceeds ten times the previous month's pay, or when there was no pay in the previous month; both are detected and reported rather than silently mis-taxed.

parameters.name: bonus
parameters.description: Gross bonus in yen.

parameters.name: previous_month_pay
parameters.description: Gross pay in the month before the bonus.

parameters.name: previous_month_insurance
parameters.description: Social insurance deducted from that pay.

parameters.name: bonus_insurance
parameters.description: Social insurance deducted from THIS bonus. The tax is charged on the bonus after it (所得税法第186条第2項), so leaving it out overstates the tax by roughly 3,000 yen on a 500,000 yen bonus. GET /v1/bonus-insurance computes the figure.

parameters.name: dependants
parameters.description: 源泉控除対象親族の数.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: 甲 or 乙 column.

get.summary: Social insurance on a bonus
get.description: Premiums on 標準賞与額 — the bonus truncated to the thousand yen. The two caps behave differently and are routinely conflated: health, long-term care and child support cap at 5,730,000 yen per fiscal year cumulatively, while pension caps at 1,500,000 yen per payment. The annual cap depends on bonuses already paid, so pass fiscal_year_to_date or it cannot apply.

parameters.name: prefecture
parameters.description: English name, Japanese, or JIS code 1-47.

parameters.name: bonus
parameters.description: Gross bonus in yen.

parameters.name: fiscal_year_to_date
parameters.description: 標準賞与額 already counted since 1 April, for the annual cap.

parameters.name: age
parameters.description: Age. Either this or birth_date is required, for the same reason as on the monthly payslip. Prefer birth_date.

parameters.name: birth_date
parameters.description: Birth date. More accurate than age: coverage turns on the day before a birthday (年齢計算ニ関スル法律).

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Date to judge age against. Defaults to today.

post.summary: Up to 500 payslips in one call
post.description: The same calculation as /v1/payroll, applied to a list of employees with shared defaults, plus run totals. Rows that fail validation come back as errors carrying their index and id; the rest still compute. Add ?detail=compact for payout figures only, roughly a tenth the response size.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: compact returns payout figures only.

defaults.description: Applied to any row that omits the field.

get.summary: Is a 随時改定 (月額変更) due?
get.description:
Judges whether a pay change forces the standard remuneration to be revised, and answers separately for health insurance and pension — the two tables differ, so a change can move one and not the other, which is normal for higher earners because the pension table stops at grade 32.

Three things must all hold: fixed pay actually changed, all three months reached the payment-basis-day threshold, and the grade moved far enough. None of that is in 健康保険法 — the two-grade test and the fixed-pay requirement both come from 昭和36年 保発第4号, and the notice's four single-grade exceptions at the top and bottom of each table are applied and named in the response. When it does not apply, the response says which requirement failed rather than returning a bare false.

parameters.name: current_remuneration
parameters.description: The 報酬月額 the current grade was based on — not the 標準報酬月額. The upper and lower exceptions turn on actual pay.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Three months as remuneration:payment_basis_days, from the month pay changed.

parameters.name: fixed_pay_change
parameters.description: Whether fixed pay rose, fell, or did not change. Overtime alone never triggers a revision.

parameters.name: worker_type
parameters.description: Day threshold is 17, except 11 for 特定適用事業所の短時間労働者. The 15-day relaxation for パート applies to 定時決定 only.

get.summary: Annual 定時決定 (算定基礎) from April-June pay
get.description: The yearly redetermination effective each September. Months below the payment-basis-day threshold drop out of the average entirely rather than counting as zero. If no month qualifies the previous grade carries over by 保険者算定 — except for 短時間就労者, who have an intermediate step at 15 days that exists nowhere else in the scheme.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The determination year. Its 1 July is the reference date.

parameters.name: acquired_on
parameters.description: Date cover began. 1 June to 1 July is outside the annual determination.

parameters.name: left_on
parameters.description: Last day worked. Someone gone before 1 July is not filed.

parameters.name: revision_month
parameters.description: Month a 随時改定 takes effect. July to September displaces the determination.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: April, May and June as remuneration:payment_basis_days.

parameters.name: previous_remuneration
parameters.description: Used only to name the grade that carries over when no month qualifies.

parameters.name: acquired_month
parameters.description: Month of enrolment, 1-12. Returns how long the 資格取得時決定 stays in force.

get.summary: Revision on returning from maternity or childcare leave
get.description: A separate route with a lower bar than 随時改定: one grade of movement is enough, and fixed pay need not have changed at all — which matters because returning part-time usually cuts pay without changing any rate. Only one of the three months has to reach the day threshold, and the months that miss it are excluded from the average. The employee has to apply; an employer cannot file it alone. It is unavailable if another leave begins the day after this one ends.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: 産前産後休業終了時改定 or 育児休業等終了時改定.

parameters.name: current_remuneration
parameters.description: 報酬月額 before the leave.

parameters.name: months
parameters.description: Three months from the one containing the day after the leave ended, as remuneration:payment_basis_days.

parameters.name: next_leave_starts_immediately
parameters.description: True if another leave began the day after this one ended, which bars the application.

post.summary: The annual 算定基礎届 for a whole payroll at once
post.description: 健康保険法第41条 decides every insured employee on the same schedule: the average of April, May and June pay, taken over the months with at least seventeen payment-basis days, applied from September to the following August. That makes June the one month where an office decides its entire payroll at once, and deciding two hundred employees one call at a time is the wrong shape for it. Each row returns the same judgement as the single-employee endpoint, plus whether that employee moved grade — which is what determines how much filing there is. A row that cannot be decided is reported in errors and the rest still run.

defaults.description: Applied to any row that omits the field.

worker_type.description: Decides the payment-basis-day threshold: 17 days normally, 11 for a 短時間労働者 at a 特定適用事業所.

previous_remuneration.description: Last year 標準報酬月額, so the response can say whether the employee moved grade.

id.description: Echoed back on the result and on any error.

months.description: April, May and June, in that order.

post.summary: 年間平均による保険者算定 for seasonal work
post.description:
For work whose April-June happens to be its busiest or quietest quarter, where the ordinary calculation would fix a grade that is wrong for eleven months of the year. Both routes exist: 定時決定 since April 2011, and 随時改定 since October 2018, the latter needing three separate grade tests to pass.

The 随時改定 figure is not a plain twelve-month average — it is the three-month average of fixed pay plus the twelve-month average of non-fixed pay, so the two are supplied separately. Both routes also require the employee's consent and that the swing recurs every year for reasons inherent to the work; neither is something an API can verify, so they are declared inputs and are reported back in the response.

type.description: regular = 定時決定, revision = 随時改定.

months.description: For regular: 前年7月 to 当年6月. For revision: the 9 months before the pay change, then the 3 after it.

recurring_annually.description: The swing recurs every year for reasons inherent to the work.

get.summary: Which months a maternity or childcare leave exempts
get.description: Maternity and childcare leave look alike and are not. Maternity leave has no day-count test and exempts bonus premiums unconditionally; childcare leave gained a 14-day rule in October 2022 and exempts bonus premiums only when the leave exceeds one month. Two consequences catch implementations out: a leave ending mid-month exempts nothing by itself, and a single day of leave on the last day of a month is exempt. Employment insurance is never exempt — it is charged on wages actually paid.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: 産前産後休業 or 育児休業等.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: First day of leave.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Last day of leave.

parameters.name: worked_days
parameters.description: 出生時育児休業 only: days worked during the leave, which come off the 14-day count.

get.summary: Overtime, night and holiday premiums
get.description: The rates are not simply additive. A night premium stacks on top of overtime or holiday work, but a statutory holiday carries no overtime premium at all — a day with no duty to work has nothing to exceed. Overtime past sixty hours in a month is fifty per cent, and the small-business deferral for that ended in April 2023, so it now applies whatever the headcount. Rounding follows 基発第150号, which rounds each category separately, so the total is not the same as rounding once at the end. Also lists the seven allowances that may be left out of the base, which the statute enumerates exhaustively and judges by substance rather than by name.

parameters.name: base_monthly_pay
parameters.description: Monthly pay counted in the premium base, after removing any of the seven excludable allowances.

parameters.name: monthly_scheduled_hours
parameters.description: 月平均所定労働時間 — annual scheduled days times daily hours, over twelve.

parameters.name: overtime_hours
parameters.description: Statutory overtime worked, excluding statutory holidays.

parameters.name: night_hours
parameters.description: Hours of that falling between 22:00 and 05:00.

parameters.name: holiday_hours
parameters.description: Hours worked on a statutory holiday.

parameters.name: holiday_night_hours
parameters.description: Hours of that falling between 22:00 and 05:00.

get.summary: How much of a commuting allowance escapes income tax
get.description: The same allowance lands in two different bases. Social insurance counts it as remuneration in full, while income tax is charged only on what exceeds the statutory ceiling — 150,000 a month by train, or a figure set by one-way distance for a car or bicycle, with up to 5,000 more for parking the employee pays for. That asymmetry is the heart of Japanese payroll, and a single gross-pay figure cannot express it. The table moved twice in twelve months: a cabinet order promulgated in November 2025 raised every band over ten kilometres and applied retroactively to allowances payable from April 2025, then April 2026 added four bands above sixty-five kilometres. Copies of this table go stale, and the response records both revisions so you can tell which figures you are holding.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: The commuting allowance actually paid, per month. Leave it out to get the whole table instead.

parameters.name: distance_km
parameters.description: One-way distance for a commute by car or bicycle. Under two kilometres nothing is exempt.

parameters.name: fare
parameters.description: Reasonable fare or toll paid alongside the vehicle commute.

parameters.name: parking
parameters.description: Monthly parking cost the employee bears. Added to the distance band, up to 5,000. Needs distance_km.

get.summary: Is this person insured, and on which day-count?
get.description: 健康保険法第3条第1項第9号 insures anyone whose weekly hours and monthly days reach three-quarters of a comparable full-time worker. Below that, cover turns on four further tests: twenty hours a week, 88,000 yen a month, not a student, and a workplace of at least fifty-one insured people. This is the classification Japanese payroll gets wrong most often, and it moves a real number: the annual determination counts months of seventeen payment-basis days for an ordinary employee and eleven for a 短時間労働者, so a misclassification silently changes which months count. Every test comes back with the provision it rests on and whether it passed, and the 88,000 figure excludes overtime, bonuses, commuting and family allowances — folding those in is the usual way people arrive at the wrong answer. The headcount threshold steps down over the coming years, so the schedule is returned rather than left as a number to copy.

parameters.name: weekly_hours
parameters.description: 1週間の所定労働時間.

parameters.name: normal_weekly_hours
parameters.description: The same figure for a comparable full-time worker. Defaults to 40.

parameters.name: monthly_days
parameters.description: 1月間の所定労働日数. The article tests days as well as hours.

parameters.name: normal_monthly_days
parameters.description: The same figure for a comparable full-time worker.

parameters.name: monthly_wage
parameters.description: 所定内賃金の月額, excluding overtime, bonuses, commuting and family allowances.

parameters.name: is_student
parameters.description: 学生 under 学校教育法. Night-course and graduating students are exceptions.

parameters.name: workplace_insured_count
parameters.description: Pension-insured headcount at the employer, short-time workers excluded.

parameters.name: employment_months
parameters.description: Expected length of the engagement, in months.

get.summary: Is social insurance due in a joining or leaving month?
get.description: Coverage ends the day after the last day worked, not on it, so someone leaving on the last day of a month loses coverage in the next month and still owes that month's premium — while leaving one day earlier means no premium at all. This is the single most common payroll error at month end, and it moves a full month of premium.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month to judge, YYYY-MM or a full date. Defaults to today.

parameters.name: joined_on
parameters.description: First day of employment.

parameters.name: left_on
parameters.description: Last day worked.

get.summary: When 40, 65, 70 and 75 are reached, and what changes
get.description: Under 年齢計算ニ関スル法律 an age is reached the day *before* the birthday, so someone born on the first of a month reaches it in the previous month and their premium changes a month earlier than a naive calculation suggests. Returns the exact date each threshold is crossed and which premium starts or stops: long-term care at 40 and 65, pension at 70, health insurance at 75.

parameters.name: birth_date
parameters.description: Date of birth.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Date to judge against. Defaults to today.

get.summary: Full text of a provision this API cites
get.description:
The judgement endpoints name the statute or notice their answer rests on. This returns its actual words, so a filing can be checked against the provision rather than against this API.

Citations are written many ways in practice, and all of them resolve: abbreviations as practitioners use them (健保法43条, 厚年法81条の2, 徴収法11条), a missing 第, paragraph-level references (第43条第1項), and full-width digits. Only the provisions this API cites are bundled - roughly 28 across 8 laws. Anything else is refused rather than approximated.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: A citation. See /v1/statute/index for everything available.

get.summary: Every provision available, with its law
get.description: Lists the provisions bundled and the laws they come from, with the law number and the date the version in force took effect.

get.summary: What each dataset covers and when it changes next
get.description: Statutory figures change on fixed dates. This states the coverage and next expected revision of every dataset, so a stale figure is visible rather than silent.
